indication: Nectin-4-expressing advanced solid tumors, urothelial carcinoma among the named cohorts
intervention: [225Ac]Ac-AKY-1189 (Nectin-4-directed actinium-225 radioligand) with [64Cu]Cu-AKY-1189 imaging
biomarker: Nectin-4 expression; [64Cu]Cu-AKY-1189 uptake gates the therapeutic dose
design: Phase 1 dose escalation and expansion, theranostic pair (64Cu imaging, 225Ac therapy)
inclusion_match_notes: Prior enfortumab vedotin is explicitly permitted, which almost no other Nectin-4 protocol allows, and an alpha-emitting radioligand kills by crossfire rather than by antigen engagement on every cell, so it is the Nectin-4 re-targeting route that does not depend on retained uniform expression or on an MMAE payload. Sites include New York, Pennsylvania and Maryland. Two gates to check: a measurable RECIST lesion after SBRT to the only known nodal disease, and the 3-week washout from trastuzumab deruxtecan.

indication: Locally advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma and other solid tumors
intervention: LY4052031 (Nectin-4 ADC, camptothecin-98 topoisomerase I payload)
effect_size: ORR 47% in post-enfortumab-vedotin participants at 3.6 mg/kg (ASCO 2026 initial NEXUS-01 results)
biomarker: Nectin-4-directed; no expression cutoff stated for entry
design: Phase 1 dose escalation, dose optimization and expansion; cohort B2 restricted to prior-EV patients
inclusion_match_notes: Cohort B2 is written for exactly this patient: urothelial carcinoma, at least one prior regimen, and prior enfortumab vedotin required rather than excluded. The topoisomerase payload sidesteps the MMAE neuropathy that drove EV discontinuation, and initial phase 1 data put the post-EV response rate at 47%. Measurable disease is required for B2, corneal keratopathy is an exclusion, and the nearest sites are New York and Massachusetts.

indication: Locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer and other solid tumors
intervention: AVZO-103 (Nectin-4 x TROP2 bispecific ADC, exatecan payload), alone or with a combination agent
toxicity_flags: interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis-high-risk agents without tight monitoring
biomarker: Nectin-4 and TROP2 co-targeting; molecular test report required at screening
design: First-in-human phase 1/2, monotherapy (Part A) and combination (Part B)
inclusion_match_notes: One agent covers two of this patient's features at once, and the bispecific design is built for heterogeneous or partly lost antigen, which is the specific worry after 25 months of EV and with TROP2 only weakly positive. FDA Fast Track covers post-EV urothelial cancer, and Connecticut, Massachusetts and New York sites are within the patient's usual care geography. The exclusion that matters is a history of drug-induced ILD, which the unresolved 2026-03 chest CT read and the current deruxtecan exposure could make an issue at screening.

indication: Advanced solid tumors harboring TP53 R175H in HLA-A*02:01-positive patients; bladder cancer named among conditions
intervention: CLSP-1025 (TP53 R175H peptide-HLA-A*02:01-directed T-cell engager)
biomarker: TP53 R175H by accredited laboratory test AND HLA-A*02:01 by central assay
design: Phase 1 monotherapy dose escalation (Part A) and HLA-selected expansion (Part B)
inclusion_match_notes: Both eligibility gates are already answered in this record: HLA-A*02:01 confirmed on 2025-01 typing, and TP53 R175H reported on Guardant360 plasma in 2025-06. The catch is that the R175H call rests on a single 0.09% VAF plasma read, so the sponsor's central confirmation is the real gate and a tissue-level confirmation would be worth having first. Sites in New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Maryland; the prostate primary is covered by the exclusion's remission carve-out.

indication: Advanced solid tumors positive for HLA-A*02:01 and TP53 R175H (any solid tumor histology accepted)
intervention: NT-175 (autologous TCR-T targeting TP53 R175H) after fludarabine/cyclophosphamide lymphodepletion
endpoint: Safety and DLT; preliminary antitumor activity
biomarker: TP53 R175H variant AND HLA-A*02:01 (at least one allele)
design: Phase 1, single infusion of engineered T cells with post-infusion IL-2
intervention_dosing: Single IV infusion after non-myeloablative lymphodepletion
inclusion_match_notes: The histology list ends in "any other solid tumor", so urothelial carcinoma qualifies on the two molecular gates alone, both of which this patient meets on paper. Apheresis material is already banked, which shortens the usual manufacturing runway. Prior adoptive cell or gene therapy is an exclusion and the ongoing mRNA vaccine series should be raised with the site rather than assumed benign; another primary within 3 years is also excluded, which the 2020 prostate treatment clears.

indication: Locally advanced or metastatic solid tumors; urothelial carcinoma in dose escalation and expansion
intervention: ASP2998 (TROP2-directed STING agonist conjugate), alone or with pembrolizumab, enfortumab vedotin or carboplatin
biomarker: TROP2-directed; prior TROP2 or topoisomerase I-directed therapy explicitly allowed
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation and expansion, monotherapy and combination
inclusion_match_notes: Urothelial carcinoma is a named escalation and expansion histology with no cap on prior regimens, and prior TROP2 or topoisomerase-payload exposure is permitted, which keeps the door open after trastuzumab deruxtecan. A STING-agonist payload is a different bet from a cytotoxic ADC and may matter less on TROP2 expression level, which is the hedge on a weak stain. New York and New Jersey sites; the enfortumab vedotin combination arms should be declined given the neuropathy.

indication: Recurrent or refractory PRAME-positive solid tumors in HLA-A*02:01-positive patients
intervention: IMA203 / IMA203CD8 PRAME-directed TCR-T, alone or with nivolumab
endpoint: MTD and recommended dose; tumor response
biomarker: HLA-A*02:01 positive AND PRAME expression by IMADetect RT-qPCR
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation with disease-specific extension cohorts including a rare-cancer cohort
intervention_dosing: Single infusion of TCR-engineered T cells after lymphodepletion
inclusion_match_notes: The HLA gate is met and the trial screens PRAME by its own RT-qPCR assay, so the 2026-08 PRAME imaging read will not substitute and the expression question stays open until that test is run. A rare-cancer extension cohort gives urothelial carcinoma a route in. Measurable disease is required, banked apheresis helps, and sites include New York, Massachusetts and Pennsylvania.

indication: Advanced cancers associated with mesothelin expression
intervention: CT-95 (mesothelin x CD3 bispecific antibody)
biomarker: Mesothelin expression (tumor types associated with mesothelin expression)
design: Phase 1a dose escalation and 1b expansion
inclusion_match_notes: Entry is written around mesothelin expression rather than a fixed histology list, which is the only way an unusual mesothelin-positive urothelial carcinoma gets a hearing. The strong 2026-08 signal came from research-grade multiplex immunofluorescence, so a validated mesothelin IHC has to come first, and soluble mesothelin as an antigen sink is worth measuring on the same visit. New Jersey and Pennsylvania sites; prior mesothelin CD3 or CAR-T therapy is excluded, which does not apply here.

indication: Metastatic genitourinary, gastrointestinal, hepatobiliary, breast, gynecologic or endocrine cancers
intervention: Neoantigen-reactive tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes with aldesleukin, after lymphodepletion, with or without pembrolizumab
biomarker: Tumor-reactive T cells against mutation-derived neoantigens identified from resected tumor
design: Phase 2 adoptive cell transfer, NCI Surgery Branch
intervention_dosing: Single TIL infusion after non-myeloablative lymphodepletion, followed by aldesleukin
inclusion_match_notes: Genitourinary tumors are named among the eligible histologies and the selection principle is the same neoantigen reactivity the vaccine program has been chasing, with 24 predicted neoepitopes and banked serial PBMCs already in hand. The binding constraint is surgical: a lesion must be resectable with minimal morbidity for TIL generation, and the only known disease is a post-SBRT nodal site. Bethesda-based, single site.

indication: Advanced HER2-expressing solid tumors
intervention: FT825 / ONO-8250 (off-the-shelf iPSC-derived HER2 CAR-T), with or without monoclonal antibodies
biomarker: HER2 expression (protocol-defined per tumor type)
design: Phase 1 dose escalation, Regimen A (FT825) and Regimen B (FT825 + cetuximab)
intervention_dosing: IV after conditioning chemotherapy, cycles of approximately 61 days
inclusion_match_notes: An allogeneic HER2 CAR-T needs no apheresis and no manufacturing slot, which matters in a case where tissue and time are both short. Eligibility runs on HER2 expression across solid tumors rather than on a histology list, and unlike the HER2 antibody and ADC trials here it does not exclude prior HER2-directed therapy. The contemporary HER2 tier from the 2026-08 stain is still the gate, and prior CAR-T or other cell therapy is excluded. Connecticut, New York and Pennsylvania sites.

indication: Mesothelin-expressing advanced solid tumors including mesothelioma
intervention: TNhYP218 (anti-mesothelin TNaive/SCM CAR T cells) after fludarabine/cyclophosphamide
endpoint: RP2D by DLT; preliminary ORR in mesothelioma
biomarker: Mesothelin expression by on-study screening assay
design: Phase 1 dose escalation in mesothelin-expressing solid tumors, expansion in mesothelioma
intervention_dosing: Single IV infusion of CAR T cells after lymphodepletion
inclusion_match_notes: Dose escalation takes mesothelin-expressing solid tumors generally, with no limit on prior regimens, so urothelial carcinoma is not excluded by histology. The trial runs its own mesothelin assay at screening, which makes a local validated stain the qualifying step rather than the deciding one. Measurable disease and one prior FDA-approved standard therapy are required; Bethesda is the only site.

indication: Advanced refractory HER2-positive solid tumors, bladder cancer among the named histologies
intervention: CAdVEC oncolytic adenovirus intratumorally plus autologous HER2-specific CAR virus-specific T cells
biomarker: HER2 IHC >=2+ (CB11 or 4B5), greater than weak-to-moderate intensity in >10% of tumor cells
design: Phase 1 BOIN dose escalation, basket across HER2-positive solid tumors
intervention_dosing: Intratumoral CAdVEC followed by IV HER2.CAR virus-specific T cells
inclusion_match_notes: The HER2 bar is IHC >=2+ rather than 3+, so this stays reachable even if the re-stain drops the tier, and bladder cancer is named in the basket. Two practical constraints: a lesion has to be accessible for intratumoral injection, and Houston is the only site. No exclusion for prior HER2-directed therapy, which separates it from the disitamab vedotin and zanidatamab protocols.

indication: Locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer after anti-PD-(L)1, platinum and enfortumab vedotin
intervention: Sacituzumab tirumotecan (sac-TMT, MK-2870) versus paclitaxel, docetaxel or vinflunine
comparator: Investigator's choice paclitaxel, docetaxel or vinflunine
biomarker: TROP2-directed; no expression cutoff for entry
design: Randomized open-label phase 3 (TroFuse-031)
inclusion_match_notes: Entry requires prior anti-PD-(L)1, prior platinum-based chemotherapy and prior enfortumab vedotin, and this patient never received platinum, so the trial is closed to him on a line-of-therapy technicality rather than on biology. That gap recurs across the registered post-EV urothelial trials and is worth flagging to the treating team as a strategic question about whether platinum is ever given. The control arm is taxane or vinflunine, both of which run against the established neuropathy.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with tumor-specific substudies including urothelial cancer
intervention: Datopotamab deruxtecan (Dato-DXd) as monotherapy or with volrustomig, rilvegostomig, platinum or fluoropyrimidine
toxicity_flags: interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis-high-risk agents without tight monitoring
severe GI toxicity / highly emetogenic regimens
biomarker: TROP2-directed; entry not gated on a TROP2 expression cutoff
design: Phase 2 modular multi-substudy platform (TROPION-PanTumor03)
inclusion_match_notes: A urothelial substudy exists in a platform whose master criteria ask only for advanced disease, ECOG 0-1, a tissue sample and one measurable unirradiated lesion, so the line requirements are looser than in the registered phase 3s. TROP2-ADC activity in urothelial cancer has not been expression-gated, which keeps a weak stain from foreclosing entry, though it also weakens the prediction. Dato-DXd carries the same deruxtecan ILD signal already at issue on trastuzumab deruxtecan, and the unirradiated-lesion requirement collides with the SBRT-treated node.

indication: Metastatic urothelial cancer, including a platinum-ineligible cohort after first-line checkpoint therapy
intervention: Sacituzumab govitecan alone or with pembrolizumab, zimberelimab, avelumab, cisplatin, domvanalimab or enfortumab vedotin
toxicity_flags: severe GI toxicity / highly emetogenic regimens
biomarker: TROP2-directed; no expression cutoff for entry
design: Phase 2 multi-cohort (TROPHY-U-01); cohort 2 is the platinum-ineligible, post-checkpoint cohort
inclusion_match_notes: Cohort 2 is the one cohort in the registered urothelial landscape written for a patient who never had platinum: it requires platinum ineligibility plus progression after first-line anti-PD-(L)1, which describes this course if the team is prepared to document ineligibility. The accelerated approval in urothelial cancer was withdrawn in 2024 after TROPiCS-04, so a trial is the only route to the drug in this indication and the efficacy expectation should be set accordingly. Connecticut, New York, Pennsylvania and Maryland sites.

indication: Advanced or metastatic Nectin-4-expressing solid tumors
intervention: CRB-701 (SYS6002, site-specific Nectin-4 ADC with MMAE payload), alone or with anti-PD-1
endpoint: MTD and payload-adjusted dose (Part A); ORR (Parts B and C)
toxicity_flags: interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis-high-risk agents without tight monitoring
biomarker: Nectin-4 expression
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation, optimization and expansion cohorts
inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility is Nectin-4 expression across solid tumors rather than a histology list, and Connecticut and Massachusetts sites are convenient, but three exclusions bite here: pre-existing grade 2 or worse neuropathy, interstitial lung disease or pneumonitis within 6 months, and a history of solid tumors other than the one under study, which the prostate primary may trigger. The lower free-MMAE design is meant to spare neuropathy, but it is still an MMAE payload in a patient with established CIPN. Reachable only if the neuropathy grades below 2 on formal assessment.

indication: Advanced refractory solid tumors
intervention: E303 (SBE303, Nectin-4-directed antibody-drug conjugate)
biomarker: Nectin-4-directed
design: Phase 1 first-in-human, all-comer advanced solid tumors
inclusion_match_notes: Entry asks only for an advanced solid tumor that progressed on or is intolerant of standard therapy, with no stated Nectin-4 cutoff and no prior-ADC exclusion in the posted criteria, which makes it one of the few Nectin-4 protocols a post-EV patient can approach without a waiver. The payload is not named in the registry record and should be asked for directly, since an MMAE payload would put it behind the neuropathy veto. US sites are Arizona and Virginia only.

indication: Advanced solid tumors refractory to standard therapy
intervention: LCB84 (TROP2-directed ADC), alone or with an anti-PD-1 antibody
endpoint: Safety and dose finding; objective response rate
biomarker: TROP2-directed; prior TROP2-directed therapy permitted
design: Phase 1 dose escalation followed by phase 2 expansion cohorts
inclusion_match_notes: Dose escalation takes any advanced solid tumor refractory to standard care and permits prior TROP2-directed therapy, so a weak TROP2 stain does not close it. The problem for this case is the mandatory pre- and on-treatment biopsies in the enrichment and expansion cohorts, against a tumor with one fresh-frozen vial left and nodal cores running 5-10% tumor content. Massachusetts is the nearest site.

indication: Locally advanced or metastatic urothelial cancer expressing HER2
intervention: Disitamab vedotin (RC48) alone or with pembrolizumab
endpoint: Confirmed objective response rate by blinded independent central review
biomarker: HER2 IHC 1+, 2+ or 3+ by central laboratory
design: Phase 2, multiple cohorts by HER2 tier, line and region
intervention_dosing: IV every 2 weeks; pembrolizumab day 1 of each 6-week cycle
inclusion_match_notes: On biomarker and histology this is the closest HER2 trial in the case, and it accepts IHC 1+ through 3+, but three exclusions close every cohort: prior HER2-directed therapy rules the patient out on trastuzumab deruxtecan alone, prior MMAE-based ADC rules out the cohorts that do not already exclude him, and baseline grade 2 or worse neuropathy is disqualifying in all of them. Cohorts A and B additionally require a prior platinum-containing line he never received. Worth logging as closed rather than leaving the board to wonder.

indication: HER2-overexpressing (IHC 3+) advanced solid tumors, urothelial carcinoma among the listed conditions
intervention: Zanidatamab (HER2-targeted biparatopic bispecific antibody)
endpoint: Confirmed objective response rate by independent central review
biomarker: HER2 IHC 3+ by sponsor-designated central laboratory
design: Phase 2 single-arm, cohort 1 pan-tumor (HER2-therapy-naive), cohorts 2 and 3 breast and gastroesophageal
inclusion_match_notes: Cohort 1 is a genuine HER2 IHC 3+ pan-tumor basket that names urothelial carcinoma, but it bars prior HER2-targeted therapy, and only the breast and gastroesophageal cohorts admit (indeed require) prior trastuzumab deruxtecan. Current T-DXd therefore forecloses the one cohort this histology fits. Central IHC 3+ confirmation would also be required, which is the same pending re-stain that governs the rest of the HER2 branch.

indication: HER2-expressing advanced solid tumors excluding breast, gastric and colorectal; bladder cohort in part 1
intervention: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg every 3 weeks
effect_size: ORR 61.3% in the central HER2 IHC 3+ population; 37.1% across all patients
toxicity_flags: interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis-high-risk agents without tight monitoring
severe GI toxicity / highly emetogenic regimens
biomarker: HER2 IHC 3+ or 2+ by local or central testing
design: Open-label phase 2, seven tumor cohorts (part 1) plus HER2-tier cohorts (part 2)
inclusion_match_notes: This is the evidence the current therapy rests on: a bladder cohort inside the pan-tumor study whose IHC 3+ population responded at 61.3%, against 37.1% overall, which is why the pending re-stain tier and not the 2023 result decides whether to continue. The trial itself no longer enrolls. Adjudicated drug-related ILD occurred in 10.5% with three deaths, which is the number to weigh against the unresolved 2026-03 chest CT read.

indication: Advanced solid tumors, multiple myeloma or B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma with a targetable genomic variant
intervention: Trastuzumab plus pertuzumab (HER2 cohort) and other FDA-approved targeted agents matched to genomic findings
endpoint: Objective response or stable disease at 16 weeks
biomarker: ERBB2 amplification or HER2 overexpression for the HER2 cohort; genomic report required
design: Non-randomized phase 2 pragmatic basket, drug assignment by genomic match
intervention_dosing: Per FDA label for the assigned agent
inclusion_match_notes: A pragmatic basket that assigns approved agents on a genomic match and accepts ECOG 0-2, which is a lower bar than the industry protocols here. The HER2 arm turns on ERBB2 amplification or overexpression, and the 2023 panel counted 12 and 13 copy-number alterations without naming them, so the pending sequencing retrieval decides whether this arm is open. Sites are broad and include Connecticut and Maine.

indication: Mesothelin-expressing solid tumors with tumor loss of heterozygosity of HLA-A*02
intervention: A2B694 (autologous logic-gated Tmod mesothelin CAR T cells) after lymphodepletion
endpoint: DLT and RP2D (phase 1); overall response rate (phase 2)
toxicity_flags: interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis-high-risk agents without tight monitoring
biomarker: Germline HLA-A*02 heterozygosity, tumor HLA-A*02 LOH by NGS, and mesothelin expression
design: Phase 1/2 of logic-gated CAR T cells, entry through the BASECAMP-1 screening study (NCT04981119)
intervention_dosing: Single IV infusion after preconditioning lymphodepletion
inclusion_match_notes: Inclusion reads "or other solid tumors with MSLN expression", so urothelial carcinoma is not excluded by histology, but entry runs only through BASECAMP-1, whose own tumor-type list does not name it, and the whole approach depends on tumor HLA-A*02 loss of heterozygosity, which is unmeasured here and is already queued as a computation on the existing exome data. A history of interstitial lung disease requiring prolonged steroids within a year is an exclusion. Low probability, but the LOH analysis costs nothing extra and would settle it.

indication: Select advanced or metastatic solid tumors with no available standard therapy
intervention: NEOK002 (EGFR x MUC1 bispecific antibody-drug conjugate)
toxicity_flags: interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis-high-risk agents without tight monitoring
biomarker: EGFR and MUC1 co-expression (select tumor types)
design: Phase 1 dose escalation with backfill (part A) and expansion (part B)
inclusion_match_notes: The exclusion that decides this row is procedural rather than biological: the most recent systemic therapy cannot have been an ADC with a topoisomerase I payload, which is exactly what trastuzumab deruxtecan is, so an intervening regimen would be needed. A known history of interstitial lung disease is also excluded. MUC1 here is a strong multiplex-immunofluorescence signal with no validated stain and no glycoform resolution, so the target call is not yet at the standard a protocol would screen on. New York site.

indication: Advanced PRAME-positive cancers in HLA-A*02:01-positive patients
intervention: IMC-P115C (half-life-extended PRAME-directed ImmTAC)
biomarker: HLA-A*02:01 positive and PRAME-positive per protocol testing
design: Phase 1 monotherapy dose escalation
inclusion_match_notes: Eligibility is the patient's own pair of gates, HLA-A*02:01 plus PRAME positivity, with no histology restriction, so this is on-axis by construction. It runs only in Australia, France, Italy and Spain, which is the reason for the weak rating rather than anything about the biology. Worth keeping visible in case a US site opens or the sponsor's other PRAME programs read out.

indication: PRAME-positive advanced solid tumors in HLA-A*02:01-positive patients
intervention: Brenetafusp (IMC-F106C) alone or with checkpoint inhibitors, chemotherapy or targeted therapy
biomarker: HLA-A*02:01 positive and PRAME-positive tumor
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation and histology-specific expansion
intervention_dosing: Weekly IV infusion after intra-patient escalation
inclusion_match_notes: The parent study for the whole PRAME ImmTAC class and the one whose expansion cohorts defined which histologies the platform pursues; it has stopped enrolling, so its value here is as the evidence anchor behind IMA203 and IMC-P115C rather than as an opening. Both eligibility gates match this patient on paper, PRAME expression excepted. Included so the board sees the class's development history alongside the two open doors.

indication: Rare genitourinary tumors, including plasmacytoid and other variant-histology urothelial carcinoma
intervention: Cabozantinib with nivolumab and ipilimumab
toxicity_flags: severe GI toxicity / highly emetogenic regimens
biomarker: Variant histology by central pathology; no molecular gate
design: Phase 2 multi-cohort by rare GU histology (ICONIC)
intervention_dosing: Cabozantinib 40 mg daily with nivolumab and ipilimumab per protocol schedule
inclusion_match_notes: This is the registered route to the CTLA-4 addition the care team is already discussing, and its cohorts cover plasmacytoid and giant-cell variant urothelial carcinoma, both of which appear in this pathology. Every variant cohort requires the variant to make up roughly 50% or more of the tumor, and the record describes focal plasmacytoid areas at diagnosis and pleomorphic giant cells at recurrence, not a predominant pattern, so a central re-read would have to carry it. The 2025 pancreatitis on checkpoint therapy is a real consideration for adding ipilimumab.

indication: Checkpoint-inhibitor-experienced solid tumors including urothelial carcinoma
intervention: N-803 (IL-15 superagonist) with pembrolizumab, nivolumab or atezolizumab, with or without PD-L1 t-haNK cells
biomarker: Prior checkpoint exposure; no molecular gate
design: Phase 2 multi-cohort (QUILT-3.055) of checkpoint rechallenge with IL-15 superagonist
intervention_dosing: N-803 subcutaneously every 3 weeks with the prior checkpoint inhibitor
inclusion_match_notes: Urothelial carcinoma is one of the enrolling cohorts and the design question is the one this case is asking, whether adding an IL-15 superagonist recovers response after progression on PD-1 maintenance. Accrual has closed, so the row exists to support the single-patient IND route already under discussion rather than as an enrollment option. N-803 is approved in BCG-unresponsive non-muscle-invasive disease, which gives an off-label prescribing path independent of any trial.

indication: Advanced solid tumors with 68Ga-FAP-2286 uptake
intervention: [177Lu]Lu-FAP-2286 radioligand therapy, gated by [68Ga]Ga-FAP-2286 PET
endpoint: DLT and RP2D (phase 1); objective response rate (phase 2)
biomarker: FAP expression demonstrated by positive [68Ga]Ga-FAP-2286 uptake
design: Phase 1/2 theranostic pair, dose escalation then tumor-specific groups
intervention_dosing: 3.7-9.25 GBq IV every 6 weeks, up to 6 doses
inclusion_match_notes: Selection runs on FAP-2286 PET uptake rather than histology, which is the right gate for a stromal target, and phase 1 accepts solid tumors generally. The one FAP scan on record showed avidity in BCG-granulomatous prostate tissue and no FAP-avid urothelial disease, so the imaging that would qualify him has so far argued the other way, and SBRT to the nodal disease adds treatment-related fibroblast activation that muddies a repeat. Retrieve the 2026-06 FAP imaging read before spending a screening slot here. New York and Pennsylvania sites.

indication: Advanced or metastatic solid tumors, with DNA-damage-response-selected expansion cohorts
intervention: ART0380 (ATR inhibitor) alone or with gemcitabine or irinotecan
biomarker: Dose escalation unselected; expansion cohorts require ATM loss or BRCA/HRD positivity
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation (parts A1-A3) and molecularly selected expansion (parts B1-B2)
inclusion_match_notes: Part A1 takes any advanced solid tumor refractory to standard therapy, so entry does not depend on the ARID1A rationale, and that is also the honest limit of the row: the expansion cohorts select for ATM loss or HRD, not for ARID1A, and the ARID1A-ATR synthetic-lethality argument remains preclinical. The pending sequencing retrieval would say whether a somatic homologous-recombination finding opens a selected cohort instead. Archival tissue submission is required.

indication: Urothelial and other solid tumors with a qualifying FGFR3 alteration; cohort B7 requires FGFR3 alteration plus HER2 expression
intervention: Vepugratinib (LY3866288, LOXO-435) alone or with pembrolizumab, enfortumab vedotin or trastuzumab deruxtecan
toxicity_flags: interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis-high-risk agents without tight monitoring
biomarker: Qualifying FGFR3 alteration; cohort B7 additionally requires HER2 expression
design: Phase 1 dose escalation and expansion (FORAGER-1), multiple urothelial cohorts
inclusion_match_notes: Cohort B7 pairs a qualifying FGFR3 alteration with HER2 expression, which is the one place in the registry where this patient's HER2 result and the unread FGFR3 status meet. Everything depends on the sequencing retrieval: FGFR3 is unknown in the derived record, and roughly 15-20% of metastatic urothelial carcinoma carries a qualifying alteration. Logged as conditional, and as an argument for prioritizing that records request; the trastuzumab deruxtecan combination arms carry the deruxtecan ILD signal.

indication: Mesothelin-expressing ovarian, primary peritoneal, fallopian tube, cholangiocarcinoma or epithelial mesothelioma
intervention: SynKIR-110 (autologous mesothelin KIR-CAR T cells)
biomarker: Mesothelin expression
design: Phase 1 dose escalation of a KIR-based CAR construct
inclusion_match_notes: The histology list is closed to ovarian, peritoneal, fallopian tube, cholangiocarcinoma and mesothelioma, so this patient cannot enroll and the row is here for the mechanism record. It matters to the mesothelin branch because the KIR-CAR architecture is a distinct attempt at the solid-tumor persistence problem that has limited conventional mesothelin CAR-T. Active invasive cancers other than the study histologies are also excluded.

indication: MUC1-expressing advanced, relapsed or refractory solid tumors
intervention: XYA02 (MUC1-directed agent)
biomarker: MUC1 expression
design: Phase 1/2 dose escalation and expansion
inclusion_match_notes: Selection is MUC1 expression across relapsed or refractory solid tumors, which fits the multiplex finding, but the study has not opened, runs in Australia only, and the registry record does not name the construct or the MUC1 epitope. Since normal epithelium carries wild-type MUC1, whether the assay resolves a tumor-associated glycoform is the question that decides whether this is a real option. Track rather than pursue.

indication: Nectin-4-positive triple-negative breast cancer, colorectal cancer or urothelial cancer
intervention: CT-202 (Nectin-4-directed bispecific antibody)
biomarker: Nectin-4 positivity
design: Phase 1a/1b first-in-human dose escalation and expansion
inclusion_match_notes: A Nectin-4-directed bispecific carries no cytotoxic payload at all, which is the cleanest way around the MMAE neuropathy problem, and urothelial cancer is one of three enrolling histologies with ECOG up to 2. It runs only in Australia, and the posted criteria give no Nectin-4 cutoff or prior-ADC rule, both of which would need asking. Prior severe skin toxicity is the one stated exclusion of note.

indication: Advanced or metastatic urothelial carcinoma with Nectin-4 positivity and assessed HER2 status
intervention: EB-DT-NK-UC101 (allogeneic cord-blood-derived Nectin-4/HER2 dual-target CAR-NK cells) after lymphodepletion
biomarker: Nectin-4 IHC >=1+ in >=10% of tumor cells with HER2 by IHC/ISH, central review
design: Phase 1 dose escalation of dual-target allogeneic CAR-NK cells with an inducible caspase-9 safety switch
inclusion_match_notes: Prior enfortumab vedotin and prior HER2-directed therapy are both explicitly allowed, which no US protocol on this list manages, and the Nectin-4 bar of IHC >=1+ in >=10% of cells is low enough to survive partial antigen loss. The trial runs only in China and strongly prefers a fresh biopsy after the most recent regimen, which collides with the tissue scarcity here. Logged so the board can see that a dual-target, post-EV, post-HER2 design exists and is enrolling somewhere.

indication: Recurrent ARID1A-mutated endometrial cancer
intervention: Tuvusertib (M1774, ATR inhibitor) with avelumab
biomarker: ARID1A loss-of-function mutation by any CLIA-certified NGS assay
design: Phase 2 investigator-initiated, single-arm
inclusion_match_notes: The one trial found that selects patients on ARID1A loss of function rather than merely tolerating it, which makes it the reference point for how strong that hypothesis currently is; it enrolls endometrial cancer only, so this patient cannot join. Pairing an ATR inhibitor with a checkpoint antibody is also the closest analogue to what the immune-intensification branch here is reaching for. Massachusetts.

indication: FAP-positive pancreatic, breast, ovarian, gastric, colorectal, esophageal and biliary tract cancers
intervention: LY4337713 (FAP-directed agent)
biomarker: Clinical or imaging evidence of FAP expression by local assessment
design: Phase 1 dose escalation and expansion (FiREBOLT)
inclusion_match_notes: Entry accepts imaging evidence of FAP expression rather than requiring a stain, which would suit this case, but the histology list stops at pancreatic, breast, ovarian, gastric, colorectal, esophageal and biliary tumors and does not include urothelial carcinoma. It stays in the file as the current benchmark for FAP-directed therapy outside the radioligand class. If the 2026-06 FAP imaging is convincing, a sponsor conversation about histology expansion is the only route.

indication: Metastatic or unresectable synovial sarcoma and myxoid/round cell liposarcoma in HLA-A*02:01-positive patients
intervention: Brenetafusp (IMC-F106C)
biomarker: HLA-A*02:01 positive; PRAME expression expected by histology
design: Phase 2 single-arm in rare PRAME-expressing sarcomas
intervention_dosing: Weekly IV infusion after intra-patient dose escalation
inclusion_match_notes: Restricted to synovial sarcoma and myxoid/round cell liposarcoma, so it is informational only, but it shows the PRAME ImmTAC class moving out of melanoma into tumors selected for high PRAME expression plus the same HLA restriction this patient carries. That is the precedent an off-melanoma request would lean on if PRAME comes back positive here. Central HLA typing is offered through the protocol.

indication: Metastatic triple-negative breast cancer
intervention: Individualized neoantigen vaccine with durvalumab, tremelimumab and chemotherapy
biomarker: Personalized neoepitopes predicted from tumor sequencing
design: Randomized phase 2 adding a personalized vaccine to dual checkpoint blockade and chemotherapy
intervention_dosing: Vaccine per schedule with durvalumab and tremelimumab
inclusion_match_notes: Triple-negative breast cancer only, so it cannot enroll this patient, and it is here because it tests the exact combination the vaccine branch of this case implies: a personalized neoantigen vaccine given with CTLA-4 plus PD-L1 blockade rather than alone. Immunogenicity after this patient's mRNA series has so far been modest and CD4-skewed, and the trials that pair vaccination with checkpoint intensification are where that argument gets tested. Connecticut, New York and Maryland sites among others.

indication: Advanced or metastatic solid tumors (all-comer dose escalation; protocol-defined expansion cohorts)
biomarker: TA-MUC1 (tumor-associated MUC1 glycoform)-directed; dose escalation not gated on a MUC1 assay, expansion requires baseline tumor tissue for protocol biomarker work
design: First-in-human phase 1/2, dose escalation (Part 1) and multi-cohort dose expansion (Part 2)
intervention: DS-3939a (TA-MUC1-directed antibody-drug conjugate, DXd-class topoisomerase I payload)
intervention_dosing: IV every 3 weeks, day 1 of each 21-day cycle; escalation from 1 mg/kg
toxicity_flags: interstitial lung disease / pneumonitis-high-risk agents without tight monitoring
severe GI toxicity / highly emetogenic regimens
inclusion_match_notes: The one MUC1-directed ADC in active development, aimed at the tumor-associated glycoform, which is exactly the distinction the validated-assay gate in this case turns on: the strong 2026-08 signal is research-grade multiplex immunofluorescence with no glycoform resolution, so a TA-MUC1-informative stain comes first. Two protocol facts then cut against access: any history of ILD/pneumonitis, or ILD that cannot be ruled out by imaging at screening, is excluded irrespective of steroids, which puts the unresolved 2026-03 chest CT read directly in the way, and the DXd payload duplicates the topoisomerase-I class of current trastuzumab deruxtecan, so sequencing two DXd ADCs back-to-back needs sponsor input even though no prior-topo-I-ADC exclusion is posted. Prior MUC1-targeted therapy is excluded (none here), the prostate primary clears the 3-year multiple-malignancy carve-out, and the nearest US site is Rhode Island.
